description: MH-52 is the Deputy Regional Transport Office (Dy. RTO) serving the Chalisgaon region in Jalgaon district, Maharashtra. Established as part of a state-wide decentralization effort in 2024, it handles vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits specifically for the Chalisgaon taluka.
address: Shastri Nagar, Bhadgaon Road, Chalisgaon, Jalgaon District, Maharashtra
